Package com.codereviewagent.api.controller

Class ReviewController

java.lang.Object
com.codereviewagent.api.controller.ReviewController
@RestController @RequestMapping("/api/v1") public class ReviewController extends Object
Maps authenticated review creation, retrieval, cancellation, and feedback requests.

      @PostMapping("/reviews/{id}/rerun") @ResponseStatus(ACCEPTED) public ReviewService.ReviewView rerun(Principal p, @PathVariable String id, @RequestBody ReviewService.RerunInput body)

      @DeleteMapping("/reviews/{id}") @ResponseStatus(NO_CONTENT) public void delete(Principal p, @PathVariable String id)
      Deletes an owner-scoped terminal review and its stored findings and feedback.
      Parameters:
      p - authenticated principal
      id - review identifier
      Throws:
      ResponseStatusException - with 404 for a missing or foreign review, or 409 while it is queued or running
